text: CI checks the decision graph on every change, docs included, for D-0096, since docs cite decisions too. D-0079 skips the gate when only docs change, so the check runs in the job that decides that, and when it fails, the gate runs and fails on the same check, which keeps GitHub's one required check covering it. The check rebuilds the graph from the checkout's journal alone, and compares the journal with the base branch's: every line the base has must still be there, in its place, so a pull request adds lines and files to the journal and never changes or removes one.
